purpose_context: omp already reaches our hub, because it imports Claude Code's MCP configuration, but the hub does not recognise it and cannot match a session to its identity. And omp's extension API can start a turn on an idle session, which is a stronger wake than Claude Code offers. This mission makes omp a known harness and gives it the same waking every other supported harness has, built on the waiter that already exists, without ever letting a message body reach the conversation as an instruction.
purpose_tldr: An agent running under omp (oh-my-pi) is recognised by the mailbox on connect, and a message sent to it while it is idle actually wakes it.
